result.detail:
No tool was run by this seat. Lint, simulation, synthesis and review evidence must come from the platform and an independent reviewer.

The testbench drives inputs and samples outputs at the falling edge. This is race-free because every DUT output depends only on registered state, as in microarchitecture section 1. It uses fork/join and timing controls, so under Verilator it needs --timing (implied by --binary).

The formal properties in the RTL are under `ifdef FORMAL`, so lint and synthesis do not see them. They are not proven because no formal_spec was submitted. The task's expected outputs do not include one. If the planner wants req:AXIL-FORMAL closed here, a single-task .sby (mode prove, prep -top axi4_lite_regs, read -formal axi4_lite_regs.v) should be added and the induction checked.
